item.title: Crunchyroll Presents: The Anime Effect Season 2 - Episode 46 - BABYMETAL’s Story Could Be an Anime
item.description: BABYMETAL is in the studio revealing the anime trios they emulate the most, their first reaction to learning they were joining the One-Punch Man universe, why metal music and anime pair together perfectly, and more.
